US oil sanctions law could impact India, China with tariffs

A US law concerning Russian oil sanctions, enacted during the Trump administration, presents a potential risk of 100% tariffs for India and China. The law, which could offer options to former President Donald Trump, has created uncertainty for India as it awaits further clarity on its implications. Trump mentioned the US's ongoing efforts to end the Russia-Ukraine war during the 81st session of the UN General Assembly.
